title: Rambutan
tagline: Unofficial YouTube Music player for Ubuntu Touch
channel_note: Early release; tested on Fairphone 5 with Ubuntu Touch 24.04 ARM64.
description:
Listen to YouTube Music with Rambutan, an independent community port for Ubuntu Touch.

Features:
- Search and play music, browse playlists and manage a playback queue.
- System Media Hub playback, including background playback and screen-off playback for tracks already prepared in the native queue.
- Track title, artist and artwork in Ubuntu Touch media controls. Volume is managed with the system controls.
- A private sign-in browser that imports and verifies YouTube Music cookies. Manual cookie import remains available as an advanced option.
- An Avalonia interface written in AXAML, integrated with Ubuntu Touch through UTDotNet.

This is an early release tested on Fairphone 5. It requires Ubuntu Touch 24.04 with the ubuntu-touch-24.04-2.x framework, ARM64 and the system Qt 6 WebEngine libraries. Older Ubuntu Touch frameworks and other architectures are not supported by this package.

Playback in the background is limited to the tracks already transferred to Media Hub; extending the queue or refreshing expired stream URLs can require reopening the app. Gapless playback, crossfade and equalizer processing are not provided by this Ubuntu Touch backend.

The sign-in browser uses a temporary private profile and does not read Morph browser data. Passwords are entered directly on Google pages. Only YouTube cookies are imported into Rambutan. If no system keyring is available, session cookies are stored in a private file with owner-only permissions, as explained in the sign-in dialog. The latest automatic import changes are covered by synthetic tests; a complete real-account verification of this release is still pending.

Rambutan is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google or YouTube. This Ubuntu Touch port is based on Rambutan by ophionos and is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later.
changelog:
Initial Ubuntu Touch preview release.
- Avalonia/AXAML phone interface with UTDotNet integration.
- Media Hub background playback with track metadata and system volume controls.
- Faster startup for uncached tracks.
- Private YouTube Music sign-in browser, automatic cookie import retries and improved on-screen keyboard layout.
- Advanced manual cookie import retained.
